explanation: He predicted the properties of several missing elements. Gallium, scandium and germanium were discovered between 1875 and 1886 and closely matched his forecasts.

claims.text: Dmitri Mendeleev published his periodic table in 1869, leaving gaps for elements not yet discovered.
Antoine Lavoisier died in 1794, John Dalton is known for his atomic theory, and Marie Curie was born in 1867; none of them published the 1869 periodic table.
Mendeleev predicted the properties of several undiscovered elements.
Gallium was discovered in 1875, scandium in 1879 and germanium in 1886.
The properties of gallium, scandium and germanium closely matched Mendeleev's predictions for them.
